title: DOMOVINA.ai — pregled
description: Što se događa sada i danas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS online FROM analytics.online_now WHERE app = 'domovina.ai'
SELECT uniqExact(if(user_id != '', user_id, device_id)) FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND toDate(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = today()
SELECT uniqExact(session_id) FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND toDate(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = today()

panels.title: Tko je sada u aplikaciji

targets.rawSql: SELECT who AS korisnik, user_id != '' AS prijavljen, platform, route AS ruta, video_id, country, city, last_seen FROM analytics.online_now WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' ORDER BY last_seen DESC

panels.description: Klik na korisnika otvara njegov profil.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, platform, uniqExact(if(user_id != '', user_id, device_id)) AS users FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time, platform ORDER BY time

SELECT video_id, count() AS prikazi, uniqExact(if(user_id != '', user_id, device_id)) AS korisnika FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND event = 'screen_view' AND video_id != '' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY video_id ORDER BY prikazi DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT route AS ruta, count() AS prikazi FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND event = 'screen_view' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY route ORDER BY prikazi DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT platform, browser, os, uniqExact(device_id) AS uredaja FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY platform, browser, os ORDER BY uredaja DESC
SELECT country, city, uniqExact(device_id) AS uredaja FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY country, city ORDER BY uredaja DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT JSONExtractString(props, 'referrer') AS referrer, JSONExtractString(props, 'utm_source') AS utm_source, count() AS sesija FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND event = 'session_start' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY referrer, utm_source ORDER BY sesija DESC LIMIT 50
